talking_points.headline: DBS wealth AUM crosses S$500bn as Q2 profit hits a record
talking_points.context_html: Tan Su Shan, CEO of DBS Group said the bank's results were "anchored by the strength of our wealth management franchise" after wealth AUM surpassed S$500 billion for the first time and Q2 net profit rose 9% to a record S$3.08 billion. That gives DBS a concrete benchmark against HSBC's own $1.1 trillion Asia wealth book, and DBS is raising 2026 guidance on the same wealth-fee momentum HSBC is counting on.
source_links: DBS posts record Q2 profit, raises guidance

talking_points.headline: HSBC's Q2 beat splits analysts despite $2bn simplification target
talking_points.context_html: Following the earnings beat covered on 4 August, reaction has turned mixed: BNP Paribas cut HSBC to Underperform and Citi moved to Neutral, while Morgan Stanley raised its price target. Joseph Dickerson, analyst at Jefferies, called the resumed $1 billion buyback "modestly lower" than expected. For Change Execution, the split verdict is a reminder that the simplification and buyback story needs sustained visible progress, not just a one-off consensus beat.

talking_points.headline: Meta's Muse Spark 1.2 raises the bar for agentic coding tools
talking_points.context_html: Meta shipped Muse Spark 1.2 alongside Muse Code, a terminal coding agent able to run persistent subagents across multi-hour engineering tasks — the latest entrant in a field that already includes Claude, GPT and Gemini coding agents. As WPB pilots AI-assisted delivery for its own engineering teams, the pace of change here is a reminder to keep re-evaluating which agent platform to standardise on rather than locking in early.
source_links: Meta ships Muse Code and Muse Spark 1.2

Competitor Intelligence.title: DBS posts record Q2 profit as wealth AUM tops S$500bn
Competitor Intelligence.summary: DBS Group reported a record second-quarter net profit of S$3.08 billion, up 9% year-on-year and ahead of analyst estimates, as wealth management assets under management surpassed S$500 billion for the first time. The bank raised its full-year 2026 guidance on the strength of wealth fees and treasury income.

HSBC News.title: HSBC's Q2 beat splits analysts as buyback underwhelms
HSBC News.summary: Analysts diverged sharply on HSBC's Q2 results: BNP Paribas downgraded the stock to Underperform and Citi cut it to Neutral, while Morgan Stanley raised its price target. The resumed $1 billion buyback fell short of the $2 billion some analysts expected, and investors read the quarter as solid but not enough to drive a sharp re-rating.

HSBC News.title: HSBC lifts debt tender offer to $6.8bn on 2028 notes
HSBC News.summary: HSBC increased the maximum size of its cash tender offer for four series of senior unsecured notes maturing in 2028 to roughly $6.8 billion, up from an initial $5 billion cap. The liability-management exercise is due to close on 12 August, settling on 17 August.

AI & Technology.title: Meta ships Muse Spark 1.2 and a terminal coding agent
AI & Technology.summary: Meta released Muse Spark 1.2, a coding-focused model update, alongside Muse Code, a beta terminal coding agent that coordinates persistent subagents across long-running software engineering tasks. The release intensifies competition among AI labs for enterprise developer-tooling market share.

Private Banking & Wealth.title: Hong Kong wealth AUM hits $5.38 trillion, SFC survey shows
Private Banking & Wealth.summary: The SFC's 2025 Asset and Wealth Management Survey put Hong Kong's total AUM at $5.38 trillion across 2,358 licensed firms, with private banking and wealth management accounting for $1.65 trillion. Hong Kong investors and mainland China contributed 37% and 9% of AUM respectively, underscoring the city's role as a cross-border wealth hub.
